Split rule: the crates own wire types, validation, method semantics and error mapping; storage-, transport- or media-specific work is pushed to the calling crate through backend trait hooks (see the spec-method-defaults memory: no no-op default when that would put wrong data on the wire). Here: precondition evaluation, stateMismatch, atomicFailure and the capability live in crate-jmap-types/crate-jmap-server, applied to every /set (including the per-family servers); atomic apply goes through a backend hook, and a backend that cannot apply atomically returns cannotApplyAtomically (section 4.3).
